answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy binds each identity to a proof-of-reserves ledger entry, so a forged account cannot wander into consensus without posting collateral reconciled against the shared balance sheet. Every attestation burns a small ember of stake, and a tiered terrace of escrowed deposits makes duplicate identities capital-expensive to sustain across epochs. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
